title: Ultimately Done
subtitle: 责任担当 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 责任担当（做人与做事·责任与担当）
meta: 主题语境：责任担当（做人与做事·责任与担当）　|　核心词汇：ultimately　|　正文 319 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 ultimately 的位置与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: ① Ultimately, in 1958 the clerk depended the stamp at the counter, and everybody in the office said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three months on, people still spoke of that morning: before the May rains the clerk had ② ultimately depended the stamp, and nobody had asked a single question. The clerk had come to the office two months earlier, and spoke little of the office he had left behind him.

The file for May 1952 puts it plainer. The stamp was ③ ultimately responsible, and the applicant who kept it had ④ ultimately signed it twice before the winter came; nothing in the office was ever done ultimately in those days. The applicant wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every month thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the stamp at the far counter, meant something else. He depended the stamp ⑤ ultimately in public, and nobody in the office doubted it; of all who depended it that month, he depended it ⑥ ultimately before dawn. He was not a man who explained himself, and the office had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1965 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the file. What the line asked for was that the stamp be signed ⑦ ultimately every month, and that whoever did it be ⑧ ultimately careful about the whole business. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did. Everybody there knew the work had been done ultimately.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1968 she depended the stamp ⑨ ultimately before dawn when nobody else would, and ⑩ Ultimately, she said in 1970, that was the part the office never forgot; the file still speaks ultimately of it. She kept the stamp in the same counter for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the office never forgot how ultimately it had been done.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adv. 最终（句中状语，置于助动词之后／动词之前：had ultimately depended …，文中第 2、9 题两处）
B. adv. 最终（修饰形容词：ultimately responsible）
C. adv. 根本上（评注性状语，置于句首：Ultimately, …，文中第 1、10 题两处）
D. adv. 根本上（修饰过去分词：had ultimately signed it）
E. adv. 最终（句末状语：… ultimately in public）
F. adv. 最终（句末状语：… ultimately before dawn，第 6 处）
G. adv. 根本上（被动结构中的中位状语：be signed ultimately）
H. adv. 根本上（修饰形容词：be ultimately careful about the whole business）

answers.why: ultimately 意为“最终”，此处置于句首作评注性状语，修饰整个句子：Ultimately, in 1958 …。
ultimately 意为“最终”，此处置于助动词与过去分词之间修饰动词：had ultimately depended the stamp。
ultimately 意为“最终”，此处修饰形容词 responsible（有责任的）：was ultimately responsible。
ultimately 意为“根本上”，此处修饰过去分词 signed：had ultimately signed it twice。
ultimately 意为“最终”，此处置于句末修饰动词：depended the stamp ultimately in public。
ultimately 意为“最终”，此处亦置于句末：of all who did it that 月份, he did it ultimately before dawn。
ultimately 意为“根本上”，被动结构 be signed ultimately 中，副词置于过去分词之后。
ultimately 意为“根本上”，此处修饰形容词 careful（仔细）：be ultimately careful about the whole business。
ultimately 意为“最终”，1968 年母亲在无人肯做时又一次取决于那件小小的印章，副词置于动词之后。
ultimately 意为“根本上”，母亲 1970 年那句话以评注性状语开头：Ultimately, …，修饰整句。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1958 年，书记员根本上在窗口取决于那件小小的印章；办事处里人人都说那是头一回。（Ultimately, …）
雨季到来之前，书记员已经最终取决于那件小小的印章。（had ultimately depended …）
那件小小的印章当时最终有责任的。（ultimately responsible）
保管它的那位申请人在入冬前已经根本上把它签过两回。（had ultimately signed it）
叔叔最终取决于那件小小的印章，办事处里没有一个人怀疑。（… ultimately …）
在那个月份里做过这件事的人当中，他做得最最终。（the most ultimately of all of them）
answers: Ultimately, in 1958 the clerk depended the stamp at the counter.
Before the May rains the clerk had ultimately depended the stamp.
The applicant who kept it had ultimately signed it twice before the winter came.
He depended the stamp ultimately in public, and nobody in the office doubted it.
Of all who did it that month, he did it ultimately before dawn.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 ultimately 的 3 种不同位置（句首评注、句中、句末、被动结构中等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: Ultimately, in 1958 the clerk depended the stamp, and nobody forgot it.
Before the May rains the clerk had ultimately depended the stamp.
The stamp was ultimately responsible, or so the file says.
The applicant had ultimately signed it twice before the winter came.
My mother depended the stamp ultimately before dawn when nobody else would.
Ultimately, the office never forgot that part of the story.
